# WB Wood

> WB Wood is a leading office furniture and commercial design solutions provider serving corporate, educational, and healthcare sectors across North America.

WB Wood specializes in comprehensive furniture solutions including project management, interior design, delivery, and installation services. The company partners with premium brands like Haworth and serves clients across New York, New Jersey, and Miami.

## Key Topics

- Office Furniture
- Interior Design

- Commercial Spaces
